property_summary: For every call, C.transfer reverts whenever the _tos array is empty (require(_tos.length > 0)); the mutant replacing that with >= 0 allows empty _tos and thus violates this rule by not reverting for an empty array.
change_summary: Change require to require(_tos.length >= 0) so the precondition never reverts (uint length always >=0), altering inputs that originally caused a revert when _tos is empty.
